dataTools.title: Database & Data Tools
dataTools.subtitle: Export encrypted or snapshot backups, inspect SQLite integrity, and import external profiles safely.
dataTools.exportDesc: Create an atomic, compacted SQLite snapshot (VACUUM INTO) with a deterministic SHA-256 sidecar checksum.
dataTools.integrityDesc: Runs PRAGMA integrity_check and validates SQLite master schemas against the whitelist.
dataTools.databaseHealthy: Database is healthy and schema is valid.
dataTools.importDesc: Safely import an external typing_freex.db backup. Subjected to a rigorous 10-stage hostile-file validation pipeline.
dataTools.importNotice: Profile database import is now located in the Main Menu.
dataTools.destinationDesc: Clicking export opens your system File Manager so you can choose exactly where to save your backup copy.
dataTools.diagnosticScopeDesc: Validates internal database pages against corruption, checks schema conformance, and audits foreign key constraints.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your typing experience, aesthetics, and accessibility options.
settings.themeModeDesc: Select light, dark, or system preference.
settings.speedUnitDesc: WPM (Words per Minute) or CPM (Characters per Minute).
settings.backspaceThroughWordsDesc: Allow backspacing into previous words after pressing space. Only applies in Normal difficulty (disabled by default like standard typing tests).
settings.forgivingAccuracyDesc: Mistakes corrected with backspace before pressing space do not penalize accuracy. Only applies in Normal difficulty (ideal for practical writing practice).
settings.enableHandGuideDesc: Real-time ASCII robot hands showing finger positioning (toggle with {key}).
settings.handGuideModeDesc: Displays virtual hands while typing. React shows pressed fingers, and Next guides the finger to use next.
settings.handGuideStyleDesc: Visual aesthetic of the hand guide.
settings.handGuideLegendDesc: Labels displayed above or on fingers.
settings.handGuideHandsDesc: Choose whether to display both hands or isolate one side.
settings.handGuideSizeDesc: Scale factor of the virtual hand guide.
settings.handGuideLayoutDesc: Target physical layout mapped to finger positions.
settings.handGuidePreviewNext: next mode preview: Left Index target
settings.handGuidePreviewReact: react mode preview: Right Thumb pressed
settings.keymapModeDesc: Displays your current layout while taking a test. React shows what you pressed and Next shows what you need to press next.
settings.keymapStyleDesc: Controls which physical layout style is displayed on the keymap.
settings.keymapLegendDesc: Controls what labels are shown on each key.
settings.keymapKeysDesc: Controls which rows of keys are shown on the keymap.
settings.keymapSizeDesc: Change the size of the keymap.
settings.keymapLayoutDesc: Controls which layout is displayed on the keymap.
settings.tapeModeDesc: Only shows one line which scrolls horizontally. Setting this to 'word' will make it scroll after every word and 'letter' will scroll after every keypress. Works best with smooth caret enabled and a monospace font.
settings.tapeMarginDesc: When in tape mode, set the caret position from the left edge of the typing test as a percentage (for example, 50 centers it).

sound.title: Sound
sound.volumeDesc: Change the volume of the sound effects.
sound.clickPackDesc: Plays a short sound when you press a key.
sound.errorPackDesc: Plays a short sound if you press an incorrect key or press space too early.
sound.timeWarningDesc: Play a short warning sound if you are close to the end of a timed test.

settings.aboutDesc: Typing FreeX is a high-performance, strictly offline desktop typing test engine with sub-millisecond input responsiveness, comprehensive metrics, and local SQLite data isolation.
settings.aboutLicenseType: GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0)
settings.aboutLicenseDesc: Free & Open Source under the GNU AGPL v3. You have full freedom to run, study, modify, and distribute with all derivative works remaining copyleft and free for everyone.
settings.aboutArchitectureDesc: Powered by Tauri v2, Rust backend, SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5 Runes, Skeleton UI v5, Tailwind CSS v4, and strictly local SQLite.
